_about: PAD-US fields: FeatClass, Pub_Access, Mang_Type (FED, STAT, DIST, LOC, NGO, PVT, JNT, UNK...), Mang_Name (a code such as CITY, REG, SDNR), Loc_Mang (the local manager name).

Manager name: managerNames[Loc_Mang] if listed (null means 'not a real manager name, use the code'), else managerNamePatterns, else Loc_Mang as given, and if that is empty or listed in unknownManagerValues, managerByCode[Mang_Name]. {stateName} is the county's state from counties.json.
Category: categoryByManager[clean name], else the first matching categoryByPattern, else categoryByMangType[Mang_Type], else 'other'.
A build prints every manager name that only reached the code fallback or was passed through unchanged, so new counties show what to add here.
_keepFeatClass: Every other PAD-US feature class (Proclamation, Designation, Marine...) is a planning or designation boundary, not land ownership, and is left out.
_publicOwnerTypes: PAD-US Own_Type values that mean public land. An easement closed to access whose Own_Type is anything else (PVT, NGO, UNK, DESG...) is an easement on private land and is left out. A closed easement on public land is kept unless it repeats a fee record.

managerNames.Urbana and Champaign: City of Urbana and City of Champaign

managerByCode.REG: Regional agency or district (name not recorded)
managerByCode.RWD: Soil and water conservation district (name not recorded)

_privateLand: Records whose PAD-US owner type is private are left out: private land is not public land. Kept: land of a land trust or similar conservation organization (manager category ngo) that is open or restricted to the public.
_duplicateEasementOverlap: An easement record is the duplicate of a fee record when at least this share of its area lies under kept fee shapes. The fee record is kept.

corrections._why: PAD-US has the Champaign County Forest Preserve District holdings badly wrong (Middle Fork River Forest Preserve at 38 acres; the real preserve is about 1,704). Where this dataset has land of a listed manager, its shapes replace the PAD-US shapes of that manager that they touch.
corrections.note: Champaign County Forest Preserve District land is drawn from the regional planning commission's open spaces, because PAD-US is out of date there. This archive combines public domain and ODbL data and is offered under the ODbL 1.0.
corrections._replaceOverlap: A PAD-US record of a listed manager is replaced when at least this share of it lies under this dataset's shapes. Otherwise it is kept and reported.
corrections._dropPadusInside: Any other PAD-US record that lies more than this share inside this dataset's shapes repeats land already drawn and is left out, whoever PAD-US says manages it.
corrections._containedOverlap: A shape of this dataset that lies at least this much inside a larger shape of the same manager in the same dataset is a duplicate and is left out.
